description:
Jack and Jill: Why Is Winter Ice So Slippery? — Jack and Jill went up the hill... and tumbled right down! But why does winter ice make everyone slip and slide so easily?
Kids science answer for "why is ice slippery science for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Ice isn't slippery just because it's cold. The very top surface of ice has loosely bonded water molecules that act like a microscopic liquid water film, dramatically reducing friction so shoes slide!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
